docs.summary: Manages tags and layers for GameObjects in the Prowl Game Engine. This class is a ScriptableSingleton, ensuring only one instance exists. The tags and layers data is stored in a file named "TagAndLayers.setting".
List of available tags for GameObjects.
Array of available layers for GameObjects.
Retrieves the tag name associated with the given index.
docs.returns: The tag name at the specified index, or "Untagged" if the index is out of range.

params.index: The index of the tag to retrieve.

docs.summary: Retrieves the layer name associated with the given index.
docs.returns: The layer name at the specified index, "Default" If index is out of range.

params.index: The index of the layer to retrieve.

docs.summary: Retrieves the index of the specified tag.
docs.returns: The index of the tag, or -1 if the tag is not found.

params.tag: The tag name to look up.

docs.summary: Retrieves the index of the specified layer.
docs.returns: The index of the layer, or -1 if the layer is not found.

params.layer: The layer name to look up.

docs.summary: Retrieves a copy of the layers array.
docs.returns: A new array containing all layer names.
